primary_target.name: Next-step same-layer routing prediction
primary_target.definition: For decode step t and each MoE layer l, predict the set of expert IDs E_{t,l} that will be routed/requested at step t in layer l (top-k experts as defined by trace/runtime semantics, k recorded in trace metadata). Input may use only information available at decision time before observing E_{t,l} and any future step t'>t.

secondary_targets.name: Short-horizon future working-set prediction
secondary_targets.definition: For each layer l at decision time t, predict the union U_{t,l,h}=Union_{i=1..h} E_{t+i,l} for preregistered horizon h. Used only as secondary/diagnostic unless explicitly promoted by a future contract version (not in R2-09B).
secondary_targets.horizon_justification: Grounded in published R2-07 DEV characterization: immediate reuse strong, reuse <=4 strong, reuse <=16 much weaker relative to shuffled null. Horizons frozen here; not selected/changed after EVAL.

input_time_semantics.causal_boundary: At decision time for step t, predictor/baseline may use past observed routing, cache state, recency/frequency/transition history, and other preregistered causal features from steps < t (or repository-equivalent causal boundary). No access to E_{t,l}, future steps, future cache events, or EVAL labels.

allowed_feature_families.note: Candidate signal, not established superior signal.
Allowed only if observable before retention decisions and explicitly preregistered/frozen before DEV tuning; not post-hoc runtime-unavailable label.
